items.title: Almost 40,000 Budget Direct customers overcharged, ASIC takes legal action
items.description: The corporate regulator is taking legal action over allegations Budget Direct customers lost online discounts they were promised and were overcharged.

items.title: Labor not ruling out negative gearing changes
items.description: A government source said it would make sense to consider changes to negative gearing and capital gains tax together, but that no decision was close to being made.

items.title: Rising tide of new voters forcing a tax rethink on property
items.description: Australian real estate now is among the world's most expensive, and that has made it a red-hot political issue as demographics shift.

items.title: Live: Sussan Ley officially resigns two weeks after being ousted as Liberal leader
items.description: Two weeks after losing the Liberal leadership, Sussan Ley officially handed in her resignation letter, triggering a by-election in the NSW seat of Farrer. Follow live.

items.title: Hillary Clinton blasts Epstein committee for Trump 'cover-up' as photo leaked during testimony
items.description: Hillary Clinton blasts a Republican-led congressional committee for summoning her to answer questions about Jeffrey Epstein while failing to push US President Donald Trump to do the same thing.

items.title: Man arrested in chaotic protest against NT Administrator
items.description: A protester has been arrested amid chaotic scenes outside of NT Parliament, where David Connolly has been sworn in as the new administrator.

items.title: After years in exile, Iran's crown prince is planning for a takeover
items.description: As the United States and Iran held their third round of nuclear talks on Thursday in Geneva amid heightened regional fears of the prospect of another war in the Middle East, Iran's exiled crown prince Reza Pahlavi says now is the time to move forward with military intervention.

items.title: Human remains found in Tasmanian wilderness 'likely' those of Celine Cremer
items.description: Police provide their strongest statement yet that human bones found in the Tasmanian wilderness are likely those of missing Belgian tourist Celine Cremer.

items.title: Inside the courts changing minds to reduce a booming prison population
items.description: The number of Indigenous people behind bars is rising. But some judges are bucking the trend by taking a different approach.

items.title: 'Massive jump' on number of first home buyers with 5pc deposit
items.description: The number of people buying their first home with a 5 per cent deposit surges after the federal government makes sweeping changes to the scheme.

items.title: Many names may be the same, but the Matildas are no longer their 2023 selves
items.description: Although filled with familiar faces, the Matildas are now a completely different side to the one that captured hearts and minds at the 2023 World Cup. This is how a "proactive" Australian side is likely to line up at the Women's Asian Cup.

items.title: Secret bank account allegedly funded US holiday amid fraud investigation
items.description: It is the second time ASIC has accused David McWilliams and his wife, Laura Fullarton, of breaching freezing orders while the watchdog investigates allegations of NDIS-related fraud.

items.title: Live: Coles shares plummet, ASIC alleges Budget Direct overcharged customers
items.description: Shares in Coles are under pressure after the supermarket giant posted a weaker first-half profit, weighed down by court-ordered penalties.

items.title: HungryPanda justifies reporting drivers in Australia to Chinese police
items.description: The dispute between HungryPanda and some of its riders has taken another twist, with the food delivery company accusing some workers of intimidation and blackmail.

items.title: What is the best wash cycle to use on your washing machine?
items.description: Eco, fast, cotton, heavy, intense cold? Experts on the most cost-effective and efficient wash cycles for your home.

items.title: Our critics won't stop listening to these 10 albums from 2026
items.description: This year has already given us a bounty of beautiful new records. Here are just 10 of the best we've heard so far.

items.title: Why 150-year-old fairy tales still resonate with modern audiences
items.description: Two wildly different shows, The Tree of Light by Slingsby Theatre Company and Meow Meow's The Red Shoes, re-imagine classic fairy tales by the famous Danish author.

items.title: Weekly news quiz: A lonely monkey, a BAFTA winner and the end of the Olympics
items.description: It's been a big week in the news. Did you catch these stories?

items.title: Scientology and Jehovah's Witnesses among alleged high-control groups
items.description: An analysis of submissions to Victoria's inquiry into cults and fringe groups shows many of the groups hold charity status.

items.title: 40 flood rescues in three hours after heavy rain hits Sydney
items.description: Dozens of people needed to be rescued and thousands of properties were without power after intense rainfall and flash flooding wreaked havoc across Sydney.

items.title: Childcare centres that failed standards to remain secret unless funding cut
items.description: Nine childcare services that have failed to lift standards will only be named if the federal government decides to cut their taxpayer funding.

items.title: US and Iran make 'significant progress' in nuclear talks, mediator says
items.description: While the US did not comment after the talks ended, Iran's foreign minister told Iranian state television they had been the most intense exchanges between the two countries.

items.title: Blind refugee dies after detention by US border agents
items.description: Nurul Amin Shah Alam's family had expected him to be released from a New York jail and reported him missing. He was found dead after temperatures dropped below freezing.

items.title: Farming town rattled by more than 70 'mysterious' earthquakes
items.description: After a dozen earthquakes in a single day and more than 70 over the course of February, farmers in Gnowangerup are curious about what is rumbling their paddocks.

items.title: Netflix declines to raise offer for Warner, paving way for Paramount takeover
items.description: Netflix has declined to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros Discovery's studio and streaming business, in a stunning move that effectively puts Paramount in a position to take over the fellow storied Hollywood giant.
